scope: Actual dense public BonkEnvironment reset/step/getObservationFast and native info versus pinned original dynamic Classic createNewState/step. Moving maps, contacts, timed capture, instant goal, sparse removed-disc death presentation, immediate respawn, native rollover, and frameSkip1/3 are checked on every call. Elimination/truncation terminal holds are a separate public policy: the frozen terminal presentation is checked, not subsequent native simulation. Direct worker/batch transports and reward values are outside this comparator.
